integrity: A symbolic proof and a separate finite sanity-check file are provided; the finite check does not prove the infinite theorem. Priority claims are qualified by available literature comparisons.
scientific_limitations: The iff theorem is specific to uniform forward two-coordinate rules on the free binary Z shift graph, with the unrestricted Borel value drawn from Chen and Zou. No claims are made for longer windows or general continuous colorings. Some directly relevant papers were accessible only at abstract level; implicit duplication in their unread full text remains possible.
title: Two-block distinguishing colorings of the binary free shift
